question: Which fast food restaurant are located within 160 kilometers on the route connecting Hashimoto Contemporary, New York, NY and Nautical Mile, Freeport, NY?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.9827 40.718445)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.581962 40.634243)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.9827 40.718445)',4326)::geography, 160000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.9827 40.718445)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);

answers.description: Blue Collar Burger is a counter-serve burger joint serving griddled burgers, fries & handmade shakes in a retro space.
